[/s][color=#a2c4c9][size=5][u]Installation:[/u][/size][/color]

[color=#e06666]SMAPI, Content Patcher and SVExpanded nedeed![/color]
1. Download 
2. Unzip/extract
3. Paste into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[u][color=#a2c4c9]Optional:[/color][/u]
4. Run the game once to generate config.json
5. Edit config.json to your liking ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086?tab=articles]tutorial[/url]﻿ )

[color=#a2c4c9]Since SVE 1.11 there are new shadows under the town buildings.
They don't match retextured shapes so this mod disables the shadows.[/color]
